stemMd: How many integers from 1 through 100 inclusive are divisible by 4 or 6?
explanationMd: There are 25 multiples of 4 and 16 multiples of 6. Their overlap consists of 8 multiples of 12. Inclusion-exclusion gives $25+16-8=33$.
